verdict.rationale: Terraform has a well-documented official CLI with headless, scriptable, JSON-structured operation (plan/apply/validate/show -json) verified hands-on via probes running plan→apply→drift-check→destroy with exit codes and machine-readable output — ideal for agentic/AI-native automation. missing for 10: no independent third-party review specifically praising CLI's AI-native/agentic ergonomics beyond first-party docs and probes.
